string.text: Take a look at this rifle. It's called the EM1, experimental. Ever heard of it?

Whoa, some contraption... No, buddy, never heard of it. Told you - don't expect any fancy gadgets from me. The electronics in there are such that I'd be scared to even take the cover off: what if I can't put it back together? Take it to someone more educated.
You like rare guns, right? What do you make of this one - the EM1?

Wow! Rare, you say... This isn't rare, this is who-knows-what. Batteries, some kind of coils... No, brother, honestly - first time I've seen anything like it. I've still got a lot to learn with rifles, and I'm not risking poking around in this thing. If I break it, I'll never pay it off.
What can you tell me about the EM1 rifle?
Nothing. Not my field. Bring me a machine gun - then we'll talk.
Take a look at this rifle. It's called the EM1. Know anything about it?

Now that's a beauty! Whatever else, lad, I've never held one of these. The scope looks good, I'll give it that, but inside it's all wires and coils - that's not my line. I'm a sniper man, and this looks more like an electrician's job. No, I don't know what kind of beast it is, and I won't spin you a yarn.
Ever seen a rifle like this? It's called the EM1.

What's that, a vacuum cleaner? No, wait... A gun, looks like. Listen, I saw all sorts at the plant, but a monster like this - first time. Maybe I'm not awake yet? No, no kidding: no idea what that thing is, and I don't want to know. You take it apart, and it zaps you. Put it away, for Pete's sake.
Ever seen a rifle like this? The EM1.

Eh, the things people drag into the Zone... No, never seen one. I live in the forest, a simple gun suits me better - a carbine, or a double-barrel. And that contraption must be one of those the scientists put together - only the Zone doesn't care much for such toys. Be careful with it, you never know.
Heard anything about the EM1 rifle?

EM1? No, never heard of it. I'm an old man, sausage and tinned food make more sense to me than all your scientific gizmos. And who'd buy a thing like that? A stalker needs a gun that shoots, not one that hums. So if you're thinking of selling it - you've come to the wrong man.
Know anything about the EM1 rifle?

EM1? Hm... No, buddy, I won't lie to you - first I've heard of it. I'm just starting out as a trader, rarities like that are way above my level. But it must be a rare piece! Maybe ask Sidorovich? Though he'll charge you just for asking.
Any idea what this rifle is? The EM1.

That's just what I was saying - nobody brings anything unique. Only this is a bit too unique: never seen one, and I've no idea what to do with it. I've got neither ammo nor parts for it. So I'm no help to you here.
Heard about the EM1 rifle?
What? Do I look like an information desk to you? I don't know a thing about your rifle and I don't want to. If you're buying - buy, if not - stop blocking the counter.
Have you heard anything about the EM1 rifle?

Listen, my friend, every bit of news about the Zone passes through me - and not once, not half a word about this! It's almost insulting, honest. A handsome rifle, a solid one... No, I don't know. But if you ever decide to sell it - you come to me first, all right?
Know anything about the EM1 rifle?

No, brother, never seen a piece like that. I moved plenty of stuff back in the Soviet days, but nothing like this. Shady gun, looks government-issue, from some agency. Easy to get burned with a thing like that. So you deal with it yourself, I'm staying out of it.
Do you know anything about the EM1 rifle?

No. And, to be honest, I don't care to. People keep bringing new ways of killing into the Zone, and then they're surprised when the Zone answers in kind. What that device is - I can't say, I don't know. Better ask yourself why you need it.
Any idea what this rifle is? The EM1.
Hm, first time I've seen one. I'm more about supplies: ammo, medkits, food... Leave experimental hardware to the technicians. Ask our mechanic, he loves tinkering with that kind of thing.
Does the military know anything about the EM1 rifle?
I know nothing. And even if I did - it's none of your business. And don't flash it around here: questions about things like that get asked by very different people.
Professor, take a look at this rifle. The EM1, an experimental prototype. Do you know anything about it?

Allow me... Curious, very curious! Judging by the coils, it's some kind of electromagnetic accelerator - the principle has been known for a long time, but for someone to bring it to a portable model... No, alas: I know nothing about this project or who was behind it. Our laboratory deals with entirely different matters. But if you ever find out where it came from, do tell me - I'm extremely interested!
